name: Astra S
summary: Astra S is a legacy structured-light RGB-D camera in the Orbbec Astra family. It supplies depth, infrared and color data over USB 2.0 with onboard depth processing. Orbbec provides OpenNI wrappers for ROS and ROS 2 for this family. Marketing ended in September 2025.

sources.quote:
EOL No.:EOL_20250220002
EOL Announcement for Astra Series
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of technological
innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone points for the Astra Series.
We hope this information will serve as a reference for your future product planning and
development.
Orbbec Inc.
February 20, 2025
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2025-02-20 EOL publicity date
EOM 2025-09-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date
when the product stops accepting orders,
including orders for new sites and capacity
expansion. After that date, the product will no
longer be sold.
EOS 2027-09-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last
date of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec
does not provide any service for the product.
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Astra Astra Pro 2/Astra 2
Astra S Astra Mini S Pro
Astra Pro Plus Astra Pro 2/Astra 2
